outcome_evidence: The oven door is initially open in image and left_ego_image (frame 0). The robot approaches the door, then raises it toward the oven through frames 63–82. By frames 115–125, image and left_ego_image show the door upright against the oven front, closing the opening. No failed acquisition, harmful collision, or displacement of unrelated objects is visibly established; the brief pauses during handling do not establish sustained stalling.
